title: BLOODLINES
lines: Bloodlines is a data center in orbit.
It keeps 950 shots from 91 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 4 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Ancestral parade receives Poet”.
The tallest tower is Moonwalk One, ca. 1970 (1970): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1904 or newer than 2016.
The sign most often read here is theatrical figure.
